info.title: Monitorable API
info.description:
The Monitorable public API. REST + JSON under /v1, authenticated with an organization API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer mon_live_…`. Keys are created by an organization owner or admin in the dashboard; the organization is implicit in the key. Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json bodies with a stable `code`. Every response carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset.

Lists return `{"data": [...], "next_cursor": "..."}`; pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page (`limit` defaults to 25, at most 100); `next_cursor` is `""` on the last page. `POST /v1/servers` accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header (at most 64 characters, remembered for 24 hours per key): a replay with the same body answers 200 with the same server and without key material, a different body answers 422, and 503 means the store is unavailable or a request with the same key is still in progress. Statuses: 201 on create, 204 on delete (no body), 400 invalid argument, 401 missing or invalid key, 402 plan limit reached, 403 missing scope, insufficient role or a range outside the plan, 404 not found (including a resource of another organization), 409 conflict, 422 idempotency key reused, 429 rate limited, 503 temporarily unavailable. Unset timestamps are `null`; optional numbers are omitted when unknown.

BadRequest.description: invalid_argument: a parameter or body field is malformed or out of range.

Conflict.description: incident_resolved: the incident is already resolved.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks what the call needs: insufficient_scope, insufficient_role, api_access_not_in_plan or range_not_in_plan.

NotFound.description: not_found: no such resource in the key's organization (a resource of another organization is indistinguishable).

PaymentRequired.description: plan_limit_reached: the plan's limit for this resource is reached.

ServiceUnavailable.description: idempotency_unavailable: the idempotency store is unavailable or a request with the same key is still in progress. Retry-After says when to retry an in-progress request.

TooManyRequests.description: rate_limited. The RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining, RateLimit-Reset and Retry-After headers say when to retry.

Unauthorized.description: The key is missing, invalid, expired or revoked, or the account is suspended.

UnprocessableEntity.description: idempotency_key_reused: the Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.

type.description: A URL identifying the problem type.

detail.description: A plain sentence about this occurrence.

code.description: The stable error code, for example not_found.

class.description: The rate-limit class; only on rate_limited.

google.protobuf.Timestamp.description: A point in time in RFC 3339 format, with up to nanosecond precision. Output uses UTC (`Z`); input may use an offset from UTC. `null` when the field is unset.

uninstall_command.title: uninstall_command

rule_type.title: rule_type
rule_type.description: The rule's type, e.g. cpu_usage, memory_usage, disk_usage, agent_offline.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: True when the rule is evaluated.

threshold.title: threshold
threshold.description:
The value the rule compares against, in the rule's unit. Omitted when the
 rule has no threshold.

window_minutes.title: window_minutes
window_minutes.description:
How many minutes the breach must hold. Omitted when the rule has no
 window.

max_notifications.title: max_notifications
max_notifications.description:
The most notifications sent for one incident. Omitted when the rule uses
 the default limit.

channel_ids.title: channel_ids
channel_ids.description: The channels this rule notifies. Empty means the template's channels.

monitorable.api.v1.AlertRule.title: AlertRule
monitorable.api.v1.AlertRule.description: One alert rule of a template.

is_default.title: is_default
is_default.description: True for the organization's default template.

reminder_interval_minutes.title: reminder_interval_minutes
reminder_interval_minutes.description:
Minutes between reminders while an incident stays unacknowledged. 0 means
 no reminders.

notify_on_resolve.title: notify_on_resolve
notify_on_resolve.description: True when a notification is sent when an incident resolves.

escalate_after_minutes.title: escalate_after_minutes
escalate_after_minutes.description:
Minutes after which an unacknowledged firing incident notifies the
 escalation channels. 0 means escalation is off.

channel_ids.title: channel_ids
channel_ids.description: The channels notified by rules that do not name their own.

status.title: status
status.description: running, paused, restarting, exited or dead.

health.title: health
health.description:
healthy, unhealthy or starting. Empty when the container has no
 healthcheck.

cpu_percent.title: cpu_percent
cpu_percent.description:
CPU use in percent of one core. Omitted for a container that is not
 running.

memory_limit_bytes.title: memory_limit_bytes
memory_limit_bytes.description: The memory limit in bytes; 0 means no limit.

memory_percent.title: memory_percent
memory_percent.description: Memory use as a percent of the limit.

rx_bits_per_sec.title: rx_bits_per_sec
rx_bits_per_sec.description: Network receive rate in bits per second.

tx_bits_per_sec.title: tx_bits_per_sec
tx_bits_per_sec.description: Network transmit rate in bits per second.

restart_count.title: restart_count
restart_count.description: How many times Docker restarted the container.

exit_code.title: exit_code
exit_code.description: The exit code. Omitted unless the container exited.

finished_at.title: finished_at
finished_at.description: When the container last stopped. null while running.

last_seen_at.title: last_seen_at
last_seen_at.description: When the agent last reported this container.

name.title: name
name.description: The server's display name, 1 to 100 characters.

monitorable.api.v1.CreateServerRequest.title: CreateServerRequest
monitorable.api.v1.CreateServerRequest.description: The name for a new server.

agent_api_key.title: agent_api_key
agent_api_key.description:
The agent's API key. Shown once, never retrievable again. Omitted on an
 Idempotency-Key replay (see recovery).

install_command.title: install_command
install_command.description:
A shell command that installs the agent with the key. Omitted on an
 Idempotency-Key replay.

recovery.title: recovery
recovery.description:
Present only on a replay of the same Idempotency-Key, which answers 200:
 how to get a fresh key, "POST /v1/servers/<id>/agent-key:rotate".
 Omitted on the first response.

monitorable.api.v1.CreateServerResponse.title: CreateServerResponse
monitorable.api.v1.CreateServerResponse.description: The new server and the means to install its agent.

usage_percent.title: usage_percent
usage_percent.description: Busy share of the processor, 0-100: user, system, iowait and steal.

temperature_celsius.title: temperature_celsius
temperature_celsius.description:
Processor temperature in degrees Celsius. 0 when the server has no
 readable sensor.

monitorable.api.v1.CurrentCpu.title: CurrentCpu
monitorable.api.v1.CurrentCpu.description: Processor load and usage. A value the agent does not report is 0.

total_bytes.title: total_bytes
total_bytes.description: Size of the filesystem, including blocks reserved for root.

used_percent.title: used_percent
used_percent.description: Used share, 0-100, with reserved blocks excluded (the figure df shows).

cached_bytes.title: cached_bytes
cached_bytes.description: Memory used by the page cache.

timestamp.title: timestamp
timestamp.description: When the snapshot was taken. null if it has no time.

monitorable.api.v1.CurrentMetrics.title: CurrentMetrics
monitorable.api.v1.CurrentMetrics.description: The latest value of each headline metric.

rx_bits_per_sec.title: rx_bits_per_sec
rx_bits_per_sec.description: Receive rate of the busiest physical interface, bits per second.

tx_bits_per_sec.title: tx_bits_per_sec
tx_bits_per_sec.description: Transmit rate of the busiest physical interface, bits per second.

interfaces.title: interfaces
interfaces.description:
Every interface the agent reports, sorted by name. An empty list when
 there are none.

name.title: name
name.description: The interface name, for example eth0.

rx_errors.title: rx_errors
rx_errors.description: Receive errors since the interface came up.

tx_errors.title: tx_errors
tx_errors.description: Transmit errors since the interface came up.

monitorable.api.v1.CurrentSwap.title: CurrentSwap
monitorable.api.v1.CurrentSwap.description: Swap space. All 0 on a server without swap.

channel_id.title: channel_id
channel_id.description: The channel's id. 0 when the channel has since been deleted.

channel_name.title: channel_name
channel_name.description: The channel's name. Empty when the channel has since been deleted.

channel_type.title: channel_type
channel_type.description:
The channel's type: email, slack, discord, telegram, pagerduty, webhook or
 ntfy. none when the attempt had no channel (alerts muted, or no enabled
 channels).

kind.title: kind
kind.description:
What the attempt was: fire, resolve, reminder, escalation, or a note that
 nothing was sent: muted, no_channels, suppressed (daily cap reached).

monitorable.api.v1.Delivery.title: Delivery
monitorable.api.v1.Delivery.description: One notification attempt for an incident.

type.title: type
type.description: The disk kind: ssd, hdd or nvme.

power_on_hours.title: power_on_hours
power_on_hours.description: Hours the drive has been powered on.

smart_passed.title: smart_passed
smart_passed.description: True when the drive's SMART overall health check passes.

wearout_percent.title: wearout_percent
wearout_percent.description:
Percent of the drive's endurance used. Omitted when the drive does not
 report it.

temperature_c.title: temperature_c
temperature_c.description: Drive temperature in degrees Celsius. Omitted when not reported.

updated_at.title: updated_at
updated_at.description: When the agent last reported this disk.

reallocated_sectors.title: reallocated_sectors
reallocated_sectors.description:
Reallocated sector count (SATA attribute 5). Omitted for NVMe and for
 drives that do not report it.

monitorable.api.v1.Disk.title: Disk
monitorable.api.v1.Disk.description: A physical disk and its SMART health. Bare-metal servers only.

name.title: name
name.description:
The server's display name: 1–100 characters after trimming. The installer
 sends the hostname by default. Ignored when server_ref matches an existing
 server (enroll never renames).

server_ref.title: server_ref
server_ref.description:
Optional: the host's stable id (instance id, Terraform self.id,
 inventory_hostname, VMID), at most 128 characters, no whitespace or
 control characters. A second enroll with the same server_ref rotates the
 existing server's agent key instead of creating another server.

name.title: name
name.description: The server's name: the existing one on a rotation (enroll never renames).

ingest_endpoint.title: ingest_endpoint
ingest_endpoint.description: The OTLP endpoint the agent writes to (its MONITORABLE_ENDPOINT).

rotated.title: rotated
rotated.description: True when server_ref matched an existing server and its key was rotated.

monitorable.api.v1.EnrollResponse.title: EnrollResponse
monitorable.api.v1.EnrollResponse.description: The enrolled server and the agent key to install on the host.

monitorable.api.v1.GetAgentCommandsReque.title: GetAgentCommandsRequest
monitorable.api.v1.GetAgentCommandsReque.description: No parameters: the commands are the same for every caller.

monitorable.api.v1.GetMeRequest.title: GetMeRequest
monitorable.api.v1.GetMeRequest.description: No parameters: the key identifies itself.

start.title: start
start.description:
Start of the range, RFC 3339 (for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Defaults
 to 24 hours before end. Must be on or after 2000-01-01.

end.title: end
end.description:
End of the range, RFC 3339. Defaults to now; an end more than 5 minutes
 in the future is treated as now.

step_seconds.title: step_seconds
step_seconds.description:
Spacing of the points in seconds: default 300, minimum 60. Raised to
 keep every series at or under 1000 points.

series.title: series
series.description:
Which groups to return: cpu, memory, swap, disk, network, connections,
 ports. Repeat the parameter (?series=cpu&series=memory) or separate
 values with commas (?series=cpu,memory). Empty returns every group.

monitorable.api.v1.GetMetricsRangeReques.title: GetMetricsRangeRequest
monitorable.api.v1.GetMetricsRangeReques.description: Window and series selection of a range query.

monitorable.api.v1.GetOrganizationReques.title: GetOrganizationRequest
monitorable.api.v1.GetOrganizationReques.description: No parameters: the key's organization is implicit.

monitorable.api.v1.GetServerMetadataRequ.title: GetServerMetadataRequest
monitorable.api.v1.GetServerMetadataRequ.description: Identifies the server whose system metadata to read.

rule_type.title: rule_type
rule_type.description:
The rule that produced it, e.g. cpu_usage, memory_usage, disk_usage,
 agent_offline.

entity.title: entity
entity.description:
What the rule concerns when it is not the whole server (a mount point or
 network interface). Empty for server-wide rules.

state.title: state
state.description: pending (breaching, not yet confirmed), firing, or resolved.

value.title: value
value.description:
The measured value at the last evaluation, in the rule's unit. Omitted
 when the rule has no value (agent_offline).

threshold.title: threshold
threshold.description:
The threshold the rule compares against, in the rule's unit. Omitted when
 the rule has none.

window_minutes.title: window_minutes
window_minutes.description:
How many minutes the breach must hold. Omitted when the rule has no
 window.

fired_at.title: fired_at
fired_at.description: When the incident started firing. null while pending.

resolved_at.title: resolved_at
resolved_at.description: When the incident resolved. null until it does.

acked_at.title: acked_at
acked_at.description: When it was acknowledged. null until it is.

acked_by.title: acked_by
acked_by.description:
Who acknowledged it: the API key's name when acked_by_api_key is true,
 else the user's name (or email). Empty when not acknowledged.

acked_by_api_key.title: acked_by_api_key
acked_by_api_key.description: True when an API key acknowledged the incident, not a user.

escalated_at.title: escalated_at
escalated_at.description:
When the unacknowledged-escalation notification went out. null until it
 has.

last_notified_at.title: last_notified_at
last_notified_at.description: When a notification for this incident was last sent. null until one has.

resolve_reason.title: resolve_reason
resolve_reason.description: Why it resolved. Empty until it does.

reminders_sent.title: reminders_sent
reminders_sent.description: How many reminders were sent while it stayed unacknowledged.

description.title: description
description.description: A one-sentence description of the incident.

server_muted.title: server_muted
server_muted.description: True while the server's alerts are muted.

deliveries.title: deliveries
deliveries.description:
The notification attempts, oldest first (at most 200). Empty when none
 were sent.

monitorable.api.v1.IncidentDetail.title: IncidentDetail
monitorable.api.v1.IncidentDetail.description: An incident with the notifications sent for it.

unlimited.title: unlimited
unlimited.description: True when the plan sets no limit; count is then 0.

monitorable.api.v1.Limit.title: Limit
monitorable.api.v1.Limit.description: A count limit of the organization's plan.

state.title: state
state.description: open (pending or firing, the default), resolved, or all.

server_id.title: server_id
server_id.description: Only incidents of this server. 0 or omitted means every server.

since.title: since
since.description:
Only incidents that started at or after this time, RFC 3339 (for example
 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

limit.title: limit
limit.description: Page size: default 25, at most 100 (larger values are treated as 100).

cursor.title: cursor
cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page.

monitorable.api.v1.ListIncidentsRequest.title: ListIncidentsRequest
monitorable.api.v1.ListIncidentsRequest.description: Which incidents to list and which page.

data.title: data
data.description: The incidents of this page, newest first.

next_cursor.title: next_cursor
next_cursor.description:
Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Empty string when this is the last
 page.

monitorable.api.v1.ListMembersRequest.title: ListMembersRequest
monitorable.api.v1.ListMembersRequest.description: No parameters: the key's organization is implicit.

monitorable.api.v1.ListServerContainersR.title: ListServerContainersRequest
monitorable.api.v1.ListServerContainersR.description: Identifies the server whose containers to list.

monitorable.api.v1.ListServerDisksReques.title: ListServerDisksRequest
monitorable.api.v1.ListServerDisksReques.description: Identifies the server whose disks to list.

monitorable.api.v1.ListServerPortsReques.title: ListServerPortsRequest
monitorable.api.v1.ListServerPortsReques.description: Identifies the server whose listening ports to list.

snapshot.title: snapshot
snapshot.description:
The snapshot the ports came from. Always present; received_at is null
 when the server has no port snapshot (an agent that predates port
 reporting, or the feature is off).

monitorable.api.v1.ListServerServicesReq.title: ListServerServicesRequest
monitorable.api.v1.ListServerServicesReq.description: Identifies the server whose systemd services to list.

status.title: status
status.description:
Return only servers with this liveness: online, stale, offline or
 dormant; any other value is a 400. Empty returns every server.

q.title: q
q.description: Return only servers whose name contains this text, ignoring case.

limit.title: limit
limit.description: Page size: 1-100, default 25; values above 100 are clamped to 100.

cursor.title: cursor
cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Empty for the first page.

monitorable.api.v1.ListServersRequest.title: ListServersRequest
monitorable.api.v1.ListServersRequest.description: Filters and paging for the server list.

data.title: data
data.description: The servers of this page, ordered by id ascending.

next_cursor.title: next_cursor
next_cursor.description:
Pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Empty string when this is the last
 page.

data.title: data
data.description:
The templates. The default template is created on first use, so the list
 is never empty.

service.title: service
service.description: The process or service name listening. Empty when unknown.

scope.title: scope
scope.description:
local when bound to a loopback address, exposed when reachable from the
 network. Empty when unknown.

families.title: families
families.description: Address families listening: v4, v6 or dual. Empty when unknown.

conn_avg.title: conn_avg
conn_avg.description:
Average open connections over the recent window. Omitted when not
 measured.

conn_peak.title: conn_peak
conn_peak.description: Peak open connections over the recent window. Omitted when not measured.

first_seen_at.title: first_seen_at
first_seen_at.description: When the port was first seen listening.

last_seen_at.title: last_seen_at
last_seen_at.description: When the port was last seen listening.

missing_since.title: missing_since
missing_since.description: When the port stopped listening. null while it is listening.

monitorable.api.v1.ListeningPort.title: ListeningPort
monitorable.api.v1.ListeningPort.description: A port the server listens on.

key_id.title: key_id
key_id.description: The key's id, as listed in the dashboard.

key_name.title: key_name
key_name.description: The name given to the key at creation.

role.title: role
role.description: "admin" or "member": the most the key can do, narrowed by its scopes.

organization_id.title: organization_id
organization_id.description: The organization the key belongs to.

plan_name.title: plan_name
plan_name.description: The organization's plan, e.g. "Pro". Empty when billing is not enabled.

expires_at.title: expires_at
expires_at.description: When the key stops working; null for a key that never expires.

monitorable.api.v1.Me.title: Me
monitorable.api.v1.Me.description: The API key making the request.

email.title: email
email.description: Empty unless the calling key has the admin role.

start.title: start
start.description:
The start of the range returned: the requested start, or the server's
 first data point when that is later.

end.title: end
end.description: The end of the range returned.

step_seconds.title: step_seconds
step_seconds.description: The step used, in seconds. This can be larger than the step requested.

series.title: series
series.description:
The series, grouped in the order cpu, memory, swap, disk, network,
 connections, ports; within a group in the order listed in the API
 documentation, and per-device series sorted by device. Empty when the
 requested window holds no data.

monitorable.api.v1.MetricsRange.title: MetricsRange
monitorable.api.v1.MetricsRange.description: A range of metrics as named series.

until.title: until
until.description:
When the mute ends, RFC 3339 (for example 2026-11-04T06:00:00Z). Omit to
 mute until lifted. Must be in the future and at most 366 days ahead.

reason.title: reason
reason.description:
Why the server is muted, shown in the dashboard. At most 200 characters,
 no control characters. Optional.

monitorable.api.v1.MuteServerAlertsReque.title: MuteServerAlertsRequest
monitorable.api.v1.MuteServerAlertsReque.description: Which server to mute and for how long.

muted.title: muted
muted.description: True while the server's alerts are muted.

until.title: until
until.description:
When a timed mute ends. null when the mute has no end or the server is
 not muted.

reason.title: reason
reason.description:
The reason given for the mute. Empty when none was given or the server is
 not muted.

type.title: type
type.description: The channel type, e.g. email, slack, webhook.

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: True when the channel is used for notifications.

last_delivery_at.title: last_delivery_at
last_delivery_at.description:
When the channel last delivered (or tried to deliver) a notification.
 null when it never has, or the delivery history could not be read.

last_delivery_ok.title: last_delivery_ok
last_delivery_ok.description: True when that delivery succeeded. false when it failed or there is none.

monitorable.api.v1.NotificationChannel.title: NotificationChannel
monitorable.api.v1.NotificationChannel.description: A notification channel. Its settings are never returned.

plan_name.title: plan_name
plan_name.description: The plan's display name, e.g. "Pro". Empty when billing is not enabled.

limits.title: limits
limits.description:
Count limits of the owner's plan keyed by limit name (e.g. "max_servers",
 "max_api_keys"). Account-wide: shared by every organization of the
 owner. Empty when billing is not enabled.

detailed.title: detailed
detailed.description: Ports the report described in detail.

all_ports_truncated.title: all_ports_truncated
all_ports_truncated.description:
True when the server has more ports than the report carried, so the list
 is partial.

monitorable.api.v1.PortSnapshot.title: PortSnapshot
monitorable.api.v1.PortSnapshot.description: The agent report the port list was built from.

monitorable.api.v1.RotateAgentKeyRequest.title: RotateAgentKeyRequest
monitorable.api.v1.RotateAgentKeyRequest.description: Identifies the server whose agent key to replace.

agent_api_key.title: agent_api_key
agent_api_key.description: The new agent API key. Shown once, never retrievable again.

install_command.title: install_command
install_command.description: A shell command that installs the agent with the new key.

name.title: name
name.description:
The series name, group first: cpu.usage_percent, memory.used_bytes,
 network.rx_bits_per_sec, disk.busy_percent, ports.connections, ...

unit.title: unit
unit.description:
The unit of the values: load, percent, celsius, bytes, bytes_per_sec,
 ops_per_sec, bits_per_sec, packets_per_sec, per_minute (network errors
 and drops per minute), or count (a gauge: connections, ports).

device.title: device
device.description:
The disk device (sda), mount point (/var) or port (443) of a per-device
 series. The empty string for every other series.

timestamps.title: timestamps
timestamps.description: The time of each point, ascending. Parallel to values.

values.title: values
values.description: The value of each point, in unit. Parallel to timestamps.

status.title: status
status.description: Liveness from the last data received: online, stale, offline or dormant.

triage.title: triage
triage.description:
Triage tier: needs_attention (an unacknowledged firing incident),
 acknowledged, unreachable (not online, no incident), healthy or dormant.

last_seen_at.title: last_seen_at
last_seen_at.description: When the agent last reported. null if it never has.

ip.title: ip
ip.description:
The address Monitorable sees the agent connect from: the IPv4 when known,
 else the IPv6. Empty until the agent first reports.

ipv4.title: ipv4
ipv4.description: The IPv4 address Monitorable sees the agent connect from.

ipv6.title: ipv6
ipv6.description: The IPv6 address Monitorable sees the agent connect from.

location.title: location
location.description: Country of the address, e.g. "Germany". Empty when unknown.

country_code.title: country_code
country_code.description:
Lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the address. Empty when
 unknown.

agent_version.title: agent_version
agent_version.description: The agent version the server reports, e.g. "1.6.0". Empty if unknown.

uptime_seconds.title: uptime_seconds
uptime_seconds.description: Seconds since the server booted, as last reported.

alerts_muted.title: alerts_muted

True while alerts for this server are muted (indefinitely or until a set

alerts_muted_until.title: alerts_muted_until
alerts_muted_until.description: When a timed mute ends. null for an indefinite mute or when not muted.

alerts_muted_reason.title: alerts_muted_reason
alerts_muted_reason.description: The reason given for the mute. Empty when not muted.

alert_template_id.title: alert_template_id
alert_template_id.description:
The alert template assigned to the server; 0 means the organization's

open_incidents.title: open_incidents
open_incidents.description:
Incidents on this server that are not resolved, pending and acknowledged

unacked_firing.title: unacked_firing
unacked_firing.description:
Firing incidents on this server nobody has acknowledged. 0 while a mute

created_via.title: created_via
created_via.description: How the server was registered: dashboard, api or enroll.

cpu_temperature.title: cpu_temperature

cloud_provider.title: cloud_provider

instance_id.title: instance_id
instance_id.description: The cloud provider's instance id. Empty when unknown.

region.title: region
region.description: The cloud region. Empty when unknown.

last_boot_time.title: last_boot_time
last_boot_time.description: When the server last booted. null when unknown.

reboot_required.title: reboot_required
reboot_required.description: True when the operating system asks for a reboot (pending updates).

permission_errors.title: permission_errors

monitorable.api.v1.Usage.title: Usage
monitorable.api.v1.Usage.description:
What this organization currently uses. Every count is this organization's
 alone; the plan limits are the owner's and are shared by all of the owner's
 organizations.

get.description:
The shell commands that update and uninstall the agent on a host. They
 carry no key and no tenant data, so any key may read them.

Lists the organization's alert templates with their rules, creating the
 default template on first use. Requires alerts:read.

post.description:
Enroll creates a server for this host, or — when server_ref names a server
 this organization already has — rotates that server's agent key and keeps
 the row. Answers 201 when it created a server and 200 when it rotated the
 key of an existing one. Requires the servers:enroll scope and an
 admin-role key. Idempotency-Key is ignored: server_ref is the retry handle.

200.description: Re-enrolled: server_ref matched an existing server, whose agent key was rotated; agent_api_key is shown once.

201.description: Created: a new server; agent_api_key is shown once.

get.description:
Lists incidents, newest first (by start time, then id). Only open
 incidents (pending or firing) are listed unless state says otherwise.
 Page with limit and cursor. Requires alerts:read.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: open (pending or firing, the default), resolved, or all.

parameters.name: server_id
parameters.description: Only incidents of this server. 0 or omitted means every server.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description:
Only incidents that started at or after this time, RFC 3339 (for example
 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size: default 25, at most 100 (larger values are treated as 100).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next_cursor of the previous page.

get.description:
One incident with the notifications sent for it, oldest first (at most
 200). Requires alerts:read.

post.description:
Acknowledges an open incident on behalf of the API key, which the
 dashboard shows as "(API key)". Acknowledging an incident that is already
 acknowledged answers 200 with the incident unchanged. A resolved incident
 answers 409 incident_resolved. Requires alerts:write and an admin-role key.

Withdraws an acknowledgement, whoever made it, so reminders resume.
 Un-acknowledging an incident that is not acknowledged answers 200 with the
 incident unchanged. A resolved incident answers 409 incident_resolved.
 Requires alerts:write and an admin-role key.

get.description: The calling key: name, scopes, role, organization and plan. Any key.

Lists the organization's notification channels with the outcome of their
 latest delivery. A channel's settings (URLs, tokens, addresses) are never
 returned. Requires alerts:read.

The key's organization with its plan limits and current usage. Requires
 account:read.
Members of the key's organization. Requires account:read.

Lists the organization's servers, oldest id first, with their liveness and
 triage state. Requires servers:read.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Return only servers with this liveness: online, stale, offline or
 dormant; any other value is a 400. Empty returns every server.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Return only servers whose name contains this text, ignoring case.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size: 1-100, default 25; values above 100 are clamped to 100.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Empty for the first page.

post.description:
Registers a new server and returns its agent key, shown once, with the
 install command. Answers 201. Requires servers:write and an admin-role
 key. Send an Idempotency-Key header (at most 64 characters) to make
 retries safe: a retry with the same key and name answers 200 with the same
 server, without the key (see recovery), and creates nothing. While the
 first request is still running, a retry with the same key answers 503
 idempotency_unavailable: wait a moment and retry.

200.description: Idempotency-Key replay: same server; agent_api_key and install_command omitted; recovery set

201.description: Created. agent_api_key and install_command are shown once.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A client-chosen key of at most 64 characters. Replays with the same key and body within 24 h answer 200 with the same server and no key material.

get.description: One server: the same row List returns. Requires servers:read.

delete.description:
Deletes a server and its data. Answers 204 with no body. Requires
 servers:write and an admin-role key.

patch.description: Renames a server. Requires servers:write and an admin-role key.

schema.title: UpdateServerRequest
schema.description: The new name for a server.

post.description:
Replaces the server's agent key and returns the new one, shown once, with
 the install command. The old key stops working. Requires servers:write and
 an admin-role key.

put.description:
Assigns an alert template to a server. A template_id of 0 resets the
 server to the organization's default template. An unknown template (or
 one of another organization) answers 404. Requires alerts:write and an
 admin-role key.

template_id.title: template_id
template_id.description: The template's id. 0 means the organization's default template.

post.description:
Mutes a server's alerts: incidents still open and still record, but no
 notification is sent while the mute lasts. Without until the mute lasts
 until it is lifted; with until it ends then (in the future, at most 366
 days ahead). Muting an already muted server replaces the end and the
 reason. Answers the resulting mute state. Requires alerts:write and an
 admin-role key.

until.title: until
until.description:
When the mute ends, RFC 3339 (for example 2026-11-04T06:00:00Z). Omit to
 mute until lifted. Must be in the future and at most 366 days ahead.

reason.title: reason
reason.description:
Why the server is muted, shown in the dashboard. At most 200 characters,
 no control characters. Optional.

schema.title: MuteServerAlertsRequest
schema.description: Which server to mute and for how long.

post.description:
Lifts a server's mute now. Unmuting a server that is not muted answers
 200 with muted false. Requires alerts:write and an admin-role key.

get.description: The Docker containers the agent reported. Requires servers:read.
The physical disks and their SMART health. Requires servers:read.

Hardware and operating-system facts the agent reported. Requires
 servers:read.

A time range of metrics as named series. start defaults to 24 hours
 before end and end to now; start must be before end. A start older than
 the plan's retention window is refused with 403 range_not_in_plan rather
 than silently shortened. A start before the server's first data point is
 moved up to it. step_seconds defaults to 300, is at least 60, and is
 raised so no series exceeds 1000 points (about span / 1000 seconds,
 rounded up to a whole minute); the step used is returned. Ranges longer
 than 7 days also count against a stricter rate limit.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description:
Start of the range, RFC 3339 (for example 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z). Defaults
 to 24 hours before end. Must be on or after 2000-01-01.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description:
End of the range, RFC 3339. Defaults to now; an end more than 5 minutes
 in the future is treated as now.

parameters.name: step_seconds
parameters.description:
Spacing of the points in seconds: default 300, minimum 60. Raised to
 keep every series at or under 1000 points.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description:
Which groups to return: cpu, memory, swap, disk, network, connections,
 ports. Repeat the parameter (?series=cpu&series=memory) or separate
 values with commas (?series=cpu,memory). Empty returns every group.

get.description: The latest value of each headline metric.

The ports the server listens on, and the snapshot they came from.
 Requires servers:read.
The systemd services the agent reported. Requires servers:read.
